title: Free agent offensive tackle Yosh Nijman retires

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Free agent offensive tackle Yosh Nijman retires
sources.description: Yosh Nijman, an offensive tackle who officially became a free agent this week after playing the last two years for the Panthers, has announced his retirement.
